figures.name: current_metric_shortlist_recovery
figures.title: Shortlist recovery under current geometric and confidence baselines
figures.caption:
48 homologs; SfaB excluded from ranking. Groups are retrospective yield definitions, not validated active/inactive labels.
All compared metrics use the same saved one-Mg ensembles. Ties use expected recovery within a tied group. Earlier Gaussian-score results do not apply to A.

figures.name: all_explored_proxy_comparison
figures.title: Complete saved comparison of 14 structural descriptors
figures.caption:
Exploratory performance on a repeatedly inspected panel; n denotes defined enzyme-level scores. AUROC uses available scores.
Definitions and orientation are retained from the saved comparison; no direction was chosen using the plotted activity labels.

figures.name: weighted_angle_scale_invariance
figures.title: A weights proximity but does not impose an absolute distance requirement
figures.caption:
Mathematical illustration, not enzyme data: angles [160°, 170°, 175°], distances [3, 4, 5] Å before scaling.
A = Σ(θᵢ/dᵢ) / Σ(1/dᵢ); multiplying every distance by the same factor cancels. Report dH alongside A.

figures.name: ensemble_distance_angle_coverage
figures.title: All 50 saved poses for every assayed homolog
figures.caption:
Rows sorted by full-ensemble A. Colors saturate outside the indicated ranges; all models remain present.
Sample index is not time. Pose fractions are prediction statistics, not equilibrium populations or biological replicates.

figures.name: finite_pose_sampling_sensitivity
figures.title: Sensitivity of current A rankings to finite pose sampling
figures.caption:
300 subsamples without replacement per size; same existing 50-pose batch. Shading: 5th–95th percentile.
This is conditional technical sensitivity, not independent sampling, biological uncertainty or prospective validation.

figures.name: best_pose_vs_pose_consistency
figures.title: A favorable pose and consistent favorable geometry ask different questions
figures.caption:
Development examples from the saved one-Mg panel. Region d < 4 Å and θ > 150° is illustrative and not prospectively validated.
Generated-pose fractions do not estimate conformational populations. Independent untested candidates are needed for a prospective test.

figures.name: activation_vs_aminolysis_readouts
figures.title:

panel
figures.caption:
48 homologs, paired saved one-Mg predictions. Neutral attacking N assigned by saved ligand formal charge and topology.
Step 2 uses pocket-localization restraints. Distance alone is not an attack-orientation or catalytic-barrier measurement.

figures.name: amine_identity_assignment

figures.name: discovery_candidate_accounting
figures.title: What the saved discovery case actually produced
figures.caption:
September 17 case: 63 evaluated, 43 representatives, 36 modeled. Seven >800-residue representatives were unmodeled in that round.
Stages are accounting categories, not biological hit rates; unmodeled candidates were not shown to be inactive.

figures.name: discovery_geometry_by_activation_route
figures.title: Structural annotations separated by the recorded activation coordinate
figures.caption:
Saved 36-candidate comparison. Blue: one Mg; orange: two Mg in the saved complex. Geometry does not override native-reaction evidence.
Substrate, metal and family differences limit cross-family score comparability; values are not universal predicted activities.

figures.name: metal_count_is_model_specific
figures.title: Metal stoichiometry is an explicit modeling assumption
figures.caption:
Saved coordinate/input counts, not experimentally measured stoichiometries. Two Mg ions are retained in the PuuA figure.
Related GS structures support metal-assisted catalysis, but AMP/ADP fate alone does not determine Mg count; PuuA-specific stoichiometry remains unverified here.

figures.name: structural_proxy_search_inventory
figures.title: Breadth of the historical descriptor exploration
figures.caption:
98 exported fields: 88 distinct nonconstant definitions, 5 duplicate exports, 5 constant/undefined fields.
Field counts include variants and diagnostics. Later matched formulas overlap this inventory; counts are not additive or independent tests.

figures.caption: The separate 2023 workbook contains calibration / repetition notes, but its limits and replicate labels are not assigned to this 2025 panel.

figures.name: PuuA_modeled_metal_distance_audit
figures.title: Two Mg ions are present in the saved PuuA prediction
figures.caption:
Distances are measurements of predicted coordinates, not validated coordination assignments or experimental stoichiometry.
Water ligands and a complete native assembly are not established by this monomer prediction; this table does not prove a physiological metal site.
